title: PepLLM: ESM-Guided Llama for Structured Protein-Peptide Binding Interface Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.21367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protein-peptide interactions are central to cellular regulation and peptide-based drug discovery, yet existing computational methods mainly focus on interaction classification, binding-site prediction, or peptide binder generation. These formulations provide limited insight into the physicochemical mechanisms that determine how a peptide binds to a protein. In this work, we introduce \textbf{PepLLM}, an instruction-tuned framework for structured protein-peptide interface understanding. Given protein-peptide sequences, PepLLM generates a machine-readable JSON annotation describing multiple interface properties, including peptide burial state, hydrogen-bond density, salt-bridge presence, hotspot residues, hydrophobicity, and electrostatic complementarity. To support this task, we construct a new protein-peptide interface dataset by integrating structural interface analysis, solvent-accessible surface area computation, hydrophobic burial

translated_title: PepLLM：基于ESM引导的Llama用于结构化蛋白质-肽结合界面分析
translated_abstract: 蛋白质-肽相互作用是细胞调控和基于肽的药物发现的核心，然而现有计算方法主要集中于相互作用分类、结合位点预测或肽结合剂生成。这些方法对决定肽如何与蛋白质结合的物理化学机制提供的见解有限。在本工作中，我们引入了\textbf{PepLLM}，一个用于结构化蛋白质-肽界面理解的指令调优框架。给定蛋白质-肽序列，PepLLM生成一个机器可读的JSON注释，描述多种界面属性，包括肽埋藏状态、氢键密度、盐桥存在性、热点残基、疏水性和静电互补性。为支持此任务，我们通过整合结构界面分析、溶剂可及表面积计算和疏水埋藏构建了一个新的蛋白质-肽界面数据集。
tldr: 本文提出了PepLLM，一个指令调优框架，能够从蛋白质-肽序列生成详细的界面属性JSON注释，包括埋藏状态、氢键密度、盐桥、热点残基等，从而提供对结合机制的深入理解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PepLLM, an instruction-tuned framework that generates detailed JSON annotations of protein-peptide interface properties, including burial state, hydrogen-bond density, salt bridges, and hotspot residues, providing deep insights into binding mechanisms.
